message: This is the Home page. Various quick stats are available in the form of widgets.

This is a widget. Widgets display various statistics or other data, and you can usually interact with them just by clicking. Once you're done looking at a widget, you can press the button to temporarily hide it. Feel free to try it out now!
There are a few sites that are not technically part of the main website, but are still under our banner. This widget lists all of them.
This is the navbar. You can reach any page on the main website this way. If you're ever unsure what the icons mean, just hover over them (or press and hold if on mobile).
Click here to load the Home page.
Click here to edit your user settings, including password, username and enabled modules.
Click here to view books that you or other users have catalogged in our library system.
